title: dc-device Device Identity
description: Result of GET /identity. Descriptive, not cryptographic: it says what a device claims to be. Authentication is a separate, later concern.

device_id.description: Must equal device.id in the manifest.

type.description: Must equal device.type in the manifest.

name.description: Must equal device.name in the manifest.

serial.description: Stable hardware-unique identifier, such as a MAC address.

profile.description: The device-class profile this device claims to implement.
